column1: # Provider email forms in a social sign-in profile: the answer go-api and auth-service give (the same on both planes).
# Driven by internal/api/session (go-api socialLogin) and internal/auth/identity/social (auth-service Exchange), each through its real provider client.

# email_hex / name_hex: the raw JSON value of the profile's email / name member, hex ("-" = a plain name). want: "pass" (the email guard lets it through) or "<status> <detail message>". shape: "-" as written, "utf16le" (the profile body as UTF-16LE with a byte order mark), "key=<K>" (the email member named K). "dupfirst=<hex>" (an earlier "email" member with that value, so the object has the key twice; the last one counts on both planes), "id=<digits>" (every numeric account id served is that integer), "noemail" (the profile has no "email" member: GitHub /user and each /user/emails entry; email_hex is not served). The email member is the exact key "email" on both planes ("Email" is no email member). verified "false" on github_emails serves the entry unverified.
